evolutionary_track_source.metallicity_note: Z=0.019 (Y=0.273) is the paper's own identified solar-composition value (Sect. 2: "almost identical to the Z=0.01886 favoured by Anders & Grevesse 1989"), the Girardi et al. (2000) grid closest to Capella's [Fe/H] = -0.04 +- 0.06 (Torres et al. 2015).
evolutionary_track_source.status_note: Real Girardi (2000) evolutionary-track/isochrone data was run against this system: VizieR catalog J/A+AS/141/371 (tables mstracks, isochron), Z=0.019 (Y=0.273), Overshoot=1. Source data: Girardi et al. (2000), A&AS, 141, 371, doi:10.1051/aas:2000126. Loader: pyseshat.evolution.parsers.girardi2000.load_girardi2000_vizier_tracks/_isochrones, wired as the default grid via pyseshat.evolution.grids.load_default_evolution_model(). Pipeline: pyseshat.evolution.benchmark_checks.run_system_evolutionary_check (nearest_track -> fit_track independently per component -> fit_common_age jointly), the same code scripts/run_evolutionary_checks.py and scripts/generate_benchmark_plots.py's generate_hrdiagrams() both use, so this recorded result, the numeric report, and the HR-diagram figure cannot silently drift apart. mass_source: derived from literature SB2 orbital elements (Torres et al. 2015 Table 1, P/e/i/K1/K2) via analysis.masses.component_masses_from_elements -- no separately-stated literature mass exists in this repository. M1=2.5688, M2=2.4828 Msun. primary: requested M=2.569 Msun -> nearest track M=2.5 Msun (2.68% off); independent best-fit age=7.676e+08 yr (0.77 Gyr), chi2=0.481, state=giant (log g < 3.0). secondary: requested M=2.483 Msun -> nearest track M=2.5 Msun (0.69% off); independent best-fit age=5.920e+08 yr (0.59 Gyr), chi2=4.106, state=subgiant (3.0 <= log g < 4.0). independent-fit age_difference: 1.756e+08 yr (0.18 Gyr) (22.9% of the older independent age). common-age (joint) fit: age=5.923e+08 yr (0.59 Gyr), chi2=45.229, primary log g=3.035 (subgiant (3.0 <= log g < 4.0)), secondary log g=3.035 (subgiant (3.0 <= log g < 4.0)). No independent literature age/mass/evolutionary-stage values are recorded for this system, so no discrepancy comparison is made. (No comparison against the source paper's own stated age, if any, is performed.)

data_provenance: REAL measurements (0.2.0): combined-light Johnson UBV from VizieR II/168/ubvmeans (V = 0.073 +- 0.014, B-V = 0.797 +- 0.012, U-B = 0.441 +- 0.010; catalogue standard deviations of 24/24/20 observations), and B and V component magnitude differences from the flux ratios of Torres et al. (2009) Table 13. Distance = 1/pi_orb from PySeshat's own orbit fit of the Torres et al. (2009) data (subset B, dataset weighting; scripts/build_real_sed_benchmarks.py, validation/results/real_sed_orbital_parallax.json). Replaces the synthetic photometry used before 0.2.0.

distance_pc.source: orbital parallax of PySeshat's real-data orbit fit

metallicity.source: nearest CK04 grid point (ckp00) to [Fe/H] = -0.04 +- 0.06 (Torres et al. 2015)

radius_prior_note: 10% relative sigma Gaussian prior on each component's radius, tied to the literature value -- same convention as the other four SED systems.

excluded_measurements.note: Hauck & Mermilliod (1998), VizieR II/215, one source, no errors; y taken as the catalogue V. Excluded: at the published parameters all four bands sit about 0.06 mag fainter than the II/168 UBV photometry (catalogue V 0.100 vs 0.073), which UBV alone does not show.
